description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that interacts with Bluetooth functionalities, setting up UI fragments and managing Bluetooth support and enabling state.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages Bluetooth setup and UI fragment initialization for a Bluetooth advertisement demo.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for Bluetooth support, and prompts the user to enable Bluetooth if it's not already enabled.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the Bluetooth enable request, proceeding if enabled or exiting if not.

methods.name: setupFragments
methods.description: Sets up and commits UI fragments for scanning and advertising Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: showErrorText
methods.description: Displays an error message in the UI.
